## Why visit

A useful contemporary addition to an old-pub itinerary: a historic townhouse arranged as a collection of small rooms, nooks and snug-like spaces, with a substantial cask offer. Its deliberately traditional styling provides a comfortable contrast to the genuinely preserved interiors nearby. The appeal is the combination of room choice and beer selection, especially when other small Georgian-quarter pubs are full. The Engineer entrance belongs to the same building and connected operation, so count this as one stop rather than two separate destinations.

## Beer

CAMRA lists several regular and changing cask beers, including local brewers among the guests. CAMRA lists Ossett White Rat as a regular cask beer, with Black Lodge and Neptune among the changing guests.
